scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
D: I want to introduce an educational transition group for two-year-olds connected with an early years preschool.
I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: Public transport proximity is preferred; threshold meets or exceeds the 75th percentile of 87.77.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 88 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
